description: This file contains functions for parsing git diffs of XML string resource files, extracting changed strings, retrieving default string values from XML files, determining language codes from file paths, and generating XML reports of string changes with localization information.

methods.name: getLocaleName
methods.description: Returns a human-readable locale name using Intl.DisplayNames, handling regional variants and fallback on errors.

methods.name: parseGitDiff
methods.description: Parses a git diff string to extract changed string resources from XML files, returning an array of changed strings with file, id, and value.

methods.name: getDefaultStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves the default string value for a given string ID from the default strings.xml file in the project repository.

methods.name: getLanguageFromFilePath
methods.description: Extracts the language or locale code from the resource folder path of a strings.xml file.

methods.name: generateXmlReport
methods.description: Generates an XML report summarizing changed strings and their translations, including locale information.
